provenance.source: Never measured on this camera. It is the value the pipeline used for any camera whose name contains ZWO, before the camera profiles existed, kept so that behaviour does not change.
The pipeline's long-standing default for raw frames: just under the 16-bit maximum of 65535, applied to every camera. It was never measured per camera.

notes: The alias ZWO CCD ASI120MC-S follows the way the ASI533's FITS header spells its name. It has not been seen in a real ASI120MC-S header.
